## Viswa Kumar

**Senior Systems Architect · Private 5G · Network Intelligence & AI**

Senior systems architect in the telecom field, currently focused on **Private 5G** with a specialization in the **packet core**. Pursuing a PhD (VAE route) on *Intelligent Network Slice Management* under Prof. Abdulhalim Dandoush. Research lives at the intersection of AI and telecom network systems — network management & automation, distributed systems, and intelligent systems.

## What is Decode?

**Decode** is a personal daily news digest — *making difficult technical material understandable*.

Each edition is a short, opinionated list of items that matter to this work and research:

- **Private 5G** — packet core, network slicing, 5G-Advanced / 6G
- **Network intelligence & AI** — network management, automation, digital twins
- **AI research** — local / edge inference, mechanistic interpretability, world models

Every item carries a **TLDR** (what it says), a **why read it** note (why it matters here), and a link to the original. The format is inspired by [The Daily Diff](https://tdd.cat).

Curated and delivered daily by [Sarathy 🪆](https://github.com/kspviswa/sarathy).
